description: This file contains TypeScript code implementing SSH sandbox session management, including creation, disposal, and command execution within SSH sessions, along with utility functions for command building and configuration handling.

methods.name: function normalizeInlineSshMaterial(contents: string, filename: string): string { normalizeInlineSshMaterial
methods.description: Normalizes SSH material contents by removing BOM, normalizing newlines, and expanding escaped sequences based on filename.

methods.name: function buildSshFailureMessage(stderr: string, exitCode?: number): string { buildSshFailureMessage
methods.description: Constructs a user-friendly error message based on SSH stderr output and exit code, especially handling crypto issues.

methods.name: export function shellEscape(value: string): string { shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Builds a remote shell command by shell-escaping each argument.

methods.name: buildExecRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a shell command string, optionally setting working directory and environment variables.

methods.name: buildSshSandboxArgv
methods.description: Builds the argument vector for invoking SSH based on session info, remote command, and TTY options.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromConfigText
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session by parsing SSH config text and writing the config to a temporary file.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromSettings
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session based on provided settings, including handling identity and host key configurations.

methods.name: disposeSshSandboxSession
methods.description: Removes the temporary directory associated with an SSH sandbox session to clean up.

methods.name: runSshSandboxCommand
methods.description: Executes a command in an SSH sandbox session, handling process spawn, I/O, and error reporting.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryToSshTarget
methods.description: Uploads a local directory to the remote SSH target, verifying symlinks and transferring via tar over SSH.

methods.name: assertSafeUploadSymlinks
methods.description: Recursively verifies symlinks within a directory to prevent escaping outside the workspace.

methods.name: walkDirectory
methods.description: Helper function to traverse directory entries and check for symlinks.

methods.name: parseSshConfigHost
methods.description: Extracts the hostname from an SSH config text block.

methods.name: resolveSshTmpRoot
methods.description: Determines the root directory path for temporary SSH files.

methods.name: resolveOptionalLocalPath
methods.description: Resolves a given path string, handling trimming and user path expansion.

methods.name: writeSecretMaterial
methods.description: Writes secret contents (identity, certificate, known_hosts) to a file with proper permissions.
